s0002 lists 郝浴子林楊素蘊郭琇; 子林 is kinship 子 plus given name 林 (Hao Yu’s son Lin), not a personal name Zilin, so the idiomatic repair is accurate.
Hao Yu; Zilin; Yang Suyun; Guo Xiu
Hao Yu; his son Lin; Yang Suyun; Guo Xiu
The same 子林 in s0002 must be read as “son Lin” in the literal; Zilin invents a compound given name the Chinese does not support.
